acceptance_scope.opaque_payloads: Only direct metadata fields in known report positions are removed from a canonical deep copy. Cases, inputs, oracle/candidate observations, diagnostics and arbitrary report extra keys remain unchanged.40 independently generated nested arbitrary-key report payloads, Unicode values and v1 collision shapes round-trip in both modes.
acceptance_scope.structural_coordinates: Reviewer locations are nonnegative [stage_index,report_index]; repair locations are [feedback_index]. They are generated by enumeration and unique within each mode. Sidecars live outside evidence, so arbitrary report/payload location/report_provenance/shared-table/reference-looking keys cannot overwrite them. Reconstruction mode is supplied by the known caller; it is not an external envelope-input protocol.
acceptance_scope.full_bindings: Presence flags distinguish absent metadata from empty maps/dicts. Path+raw-file-hash binding IDs preserve same-path/different-content and distinct-path/same-content distinctions. Map/entry/execution hash domains now include the exact canonical recipe, including ensure_ascii=True. Every captured report/command/compiler/source/ABI/count/counterexample fact restores exactly.
acceptance_scope.protected_behavior: Only preexisting repair_prompt/reviewer_prompt ASTs change, plus new formatter/constants. All existing globals, gates, snapshot/binary/report binding checks, schedules/budgets, reviewer schema/refusal, retry policy and durable status/publication logic are unchanged. The24 tests include the18 baseline synthetic pipeline checks.
acceptance_scope.public_only: Existing public/build-only repair selection is unchanged; heldout/negative observations are excluded. The generic preservation instruction applies to all passing function implementations.
acceptance_scope.reference_integrity: Independent reconstruction verifies each referenced binding/execution digest and map digest and rejects missing/tampered referenced entries. Exact comparison with original summaries also catches a dropped whole sidecar association. No production decoder accepting externally edited envelopes is added or reviewed.
